question: How do I apply for admission?
alt_questions: how to apply for a seat|apply online for the course|admission application process|admission kaise le|admission kaise milega|form kaise bharna hai
answer: At ABES, 85% of seats are filled through counselling (JEE Main based, via AKTU/UPTAC) and 15% through direct admission as per the college policy. Direct-admission candidates apply online through the ERP enquiry link on abes.ac.in/courses-offered.html. Admission enquiry: 8448494111.

question: What documents are required for admission?
alt_questions: documents needed for admission|which certificates do I need|list of documents to upload
answer: At final admission bring two self-attested photocopies and the originals of: allotment letter (counselling candidates), entrance exam result, X and XII marksheets and certificates, transfer/migration certificate, character certificate, Aadhar cards, photographs and the other documents listed on abes.ac.in/courses-offered.html.

question: What is the last date to apply?
alt_questions: application deadline|last date for admission form|when does admission close
answer: The last date is announced on the admission portal for every intake and may differ by programme. Please check the 'Important Dates' section of the portal for the current deadline.

question: What are the eligibility criteria for UG and PG programmes?
alt_questions: am I eligible for btech|minimum marks required to apply|eligibility for MCA MBA
answer: Eligibility follows UP Government / AKTU norms: B.Tech admission is through counselling on JEE Main rank and MCA through CUET rank. Programme-wise eligibility and cut-off ranks are published by the college; check the Admission Procedure page on abes.ac.in or write to info@abes.ac.in.

question: How can I check my application or admission status?
alt_questions: admission status|track my application|has my application been accepted
answer: Log in to the admission portal with your application number and password and open the 'Application Status' tab. Status updates (shortlisted, document verification, confirmed) are also e-mailed.

question: Are scholarships available for new students?
alt_questions: scholarship for admission|merit scholarship|financial aid for new applicants
answer: Merit-based and need-based scholarships are available. Apply through the scholarship section of the portal after receiving your offer; the scholarship office publishes eligibility rules every year.

question: How do I cancel or withdraw my admission?
alt_questions: cancel admission|withdraw from the programme|refund after admission cancellation
answer: Submit a written withdrawal request to the admission office with your ID card and fee receipts. Refund of fees depends on the date of withdrawal as per the university refund policy.

question: Can I transfer from another college or change my branch?
alt_questions: lateral entry|branch change|transfer to your university
answer: Lateral entry and credit transfer are considered for eligible diploma holders and transferring students subject to seat availability. Branch change requests are accepted after the first year, based on CGPA and available seats.

question: Where can I find my class timetable?
alt_questions: class timetable|weekly schedule|time table kaha milega
answer: As per the college's disclosure, the academic timetable is available in your department. Your department office or class coordinator can share the latest version.

question: When does the semester start and end?
alt_questions: academic calendar|semester dates|when does the next semester begin
answer: ABES is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow, and follows the AKTU academic calendar, which is published on aktu.ac.in. Departments announce any college-level changes.

question: Where can I find the holiday list?
alt_questions: list of holidays|is tomorrow a holiday|university holidays
answer: The official holiday list is part of the academic calendar. Any sudden holiday is announced through the portal and official student e-mail.

question: How will I know if a class is cancelled or rescheduled?
alt_questions: lecture cancelled|class timing changed|notifications for class changes
answer: Class changes are posted on the student portal and sent via e-mail/SMS by the department. Please enable notifications on the portal to receive them on time.

question: What is the laboratory schedule?
alt_questions: lab timetable|practical schedule|lab batch timings
answer: Lab batches and timings are listed in the department timetable. Your lab coordinator shares batch-wise slots at the start of the semester.

question: What are the university office and working hours?
alt_questions: office timings|college working hours|when is the admin office open|college timing kya hai|college timings|what time does college start|college kitne baje khulta hai
answer: Academic hours at ABES Engineering College are 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM. For office or counter timings of a particular department, call 0120-7135112 or e-mail info@abes.ac.in.

question: When are the vacations and breaks?
alt_questions: semester break|winter vacation dates|summer break
answer: Vacation periods are mentioned in the academic calendar. Typically there is a winter break, a mid-year break and a summer vacation; exact dates are announced each year.

question: How do I book an appointment with a professor?
alt_questions: faculty office hours|meet my professor|appointment with teacher
answer: Faculty publish weekly office hours outside their rooms and on the portal. You can request a slot by e-mail or through the portal's 'Meet Faculty' option.

question: How do I pay my tuition fees online?
alt_questions: pay fees online|online fee payment|how to pay college fee|fees kaise bharni hai|fees kaise jama kare|online fees kaise pay kare
answer: Log in to the student portal, open 'Fees > Pay Online', select the instalment and pay using UPI, net banking, debit/credit card. Download the receipt after the payment is confirmed.

question: What is the last date for fee payment?
alt_questions: fee due date|fee deadline|when is the fee instalment due
answer: Due dates for each instalment are shown on your fee challan and on the portal's 'Fees' dashboard. Please pay before the due date to avoid a late fee.

question: Is there a late fee penalty?
alt_questions: fine for late fee|penalty for delayed payment|what if I pay fee after deadline
answer: A late fee per day (as notified by the accounts office) applies after the due date. Repeated delays may block access to exam forms; contact the accounts office if you need an extension.

question: What is the fee structure for my programme?
alt_questions: how much is the fee|fees kitni hai|total cost of the course|annual tuition fee|fee for first year|fees kitni hai|kitni fees lagti hai|course ki fees|btech fee|b.tech fee structure|bca fee|bca fees|mca fee|mca fees|m.tech fee|mtech fees|lateral entry fee|working professional fee|fee for bca course|fee for mca course|annual fee
answer: ABES B.Tech fee 2026-27 is Rs. 1,81,200 per year in total (tuition Rs. 1,10,000 plus career planning, exam, technology and other heads, including a Rs. 5,000 refundable security deposit). Other programmes have their own fee tabs on abes.ac.in/courses-offered.html.

question: Can I pay my fees in instalments?
alt_questions: fee instalments|pay in two parts|part payment of fee
answer: Yes. Fees can be paid semester-wise, and the accounts office can approve an instalment plan on written request with valid reasons.

question: How do I get a fee receipt or fee certificate?
alt_questions: fee receipt download|certificate for education loan|proof of fee payment
answer: Receipts can be downloaded from the portal under 'Fees > Payment History'. For a fee certificate (e.g., for bank loans) apply at the accounts office or through the portal's 'Certificates' section.

question: What is the refund policy?
alt_questions: fee refund|get my money back|refund on withdrawal
answer: On cancellation of admission, fees are refunded as per UGC refund rules. On hostel withdrawal only the security, mess and laundry charges for unused months are refundable pro rata.

question: My payment failed but money was deducted. What should I do?
alt_questions: payment deducted but not updated|fee shows pending after payment|double payment
answer: Please wait 24-48 hours as banks usually auto-reverse failed transactions. If the fee still shows pending, e-mail the accounts office with the transaction ID and screenshot (do not share card numbers).

question: Are fee waivers or scholarships available?
alt_questions: fee concession|scholarship fee waiver|discount in fees
answer: Fee concessions are available for meritorious and economically weaker students. Applications are accepted through the scholarship section with income and merit documents.

question: When will the exam timetable be released?
alt_questions: exam schedule|date sheet|when are the exams|exam kab hai|exam kab hoga|exams kab se shuru honge|date of exams|exam date
answer: The examination timetable is usually released 3-4 weeks before the exams on the examination portal and the university website.

question: How do I download my hall ticket or admit card?
alt_questions: hall ticket download|admit card|exam entry pass|hall ticket kaise download kare|admit card kaise milega|hall ticket kahan se milega
answer: After filling the exam form and clearing dues, the hall ticket is available on the examination portal under 'Admit Card'. Carry a printed copy and your ID card to the exam hall.

question: How do I apply for re-evaluation?
alt_questions: revaluation of answer sheet|recheck my marks|apply for re-evaluation
answer: Apply on the examination portal within the window announced after results, select the subjects and pay the re-evaluation fee per paper. Revised results are published on the portal.

question: When will the results be declared?
alt_questions: semester result date|exam results|result kab aayega|result kab aayega|result kab aata hai|result date
answer: Results are normally declared within 30-45 days of the last exam. The date is announced on the examination portal and student e-mail.

question: What is the minimum attendance required for exams?
alt_questions: attendance criteria|detention for low attendance|75 percent attendance rule
answer: A minimum of 75% attendance in each subject is generally required to appear in exams. Medical or condonation requests can be submitted to the Head of Department with supporting documents.

question: What are the passing marks and grading system?
alt_questions: passing marks|how is CGPA calculated|grading scheme
answer: A student must usually score at least 40% in each subject (including internal and external components). Grades are converted into grade points on a 10-point scale and CGPA is the credit-weighted average.

question: How do I apply for a backlog or supplementary exam?
alt_questions: backlog exam form|supplementary exam|fail in one subject
answer: Fill the backlog/supplementary exam form on the examination portal during the notified window and pay the exam fee for each subject you want to reappear in.

question: How can I get my marksheet or transcript?
alt_questions: duplicate marksheet|official transcript|provisional degree certificate
answer: Apply for marksheets, transcripts and provisional certificates through the examination portal's 'Certificates' section or at the examination cell with the prescribed fee and ID proof.

question: How do I file a complaint or grievance?
alt_questions: raise a complaint|register grievance|where to submit complaint|shikayat kahan kare|complaint kaise kare|shikayat kaise darj kare
answer: ABES has a Grievance Redressal Cell (GRC), formed as per AICTE directions to handle complaints from students and staff. You can lodge a grievance through the GRC page on abes.ac.in (GRC-grievance-redressal-cell). The committee is chaired by the Director and includes the Registrar, Chief Proctor and a Member Secretary. A human support agent will also follow up.
source: ABES GRC page (https://abes.ac.in/GRC-grievance-redressal-cell.php) + Mandatory Disclosure 18-Mar-2025, retrieved 2026-10-31

question: How can I report harassment or ragging?
alt_questions: report ragging|sexual harassment complaint|bullying on campus
answer: ABES has an Anti-Ragging Committee (headed by the Director, with the Chief Proctor and Deputy Proctor), an Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) for harassment, and a Dean for Campus Life & Student Welfare (dcsw@abes.ac.in). The national anti-ragging helpline is 1800-180-5522. I am also alerting a human support agent now.
source: ABES GRC page (https://abes.ac.in/GRC-grievance-redressal-cell.php) + Mandatory Disclosure 18-Mar-2025, retrieved 2026-10-31

question: How long does grievance resolution take?
alt_questions: time to resolve complaint|when will my complaint be solved|grievance resolution time
answer: Most grievances are acknowledged within 2 working days and resolved within 15 working days. Complex cases may take longer, and you will be informed of progress.

question: How can I track my complaint status?
alt_questions: complaint status|track my grievance ticket|status of my complaint
answer: Use your grievance ticket number on the portal under 'Grievance > Track Status'. You will also get e-mail updates when the status changes.

question: What if my complaint is not resolved?
alt_questions: escalate complaint|appeal against decision|complaint to dean
answer: If a complaint is not resolved at department level, it can go to the central Grievance Redressal Cell, whose committee either upholds the earlier decision or changes it. The Institute committee also has a University (AKTU) nominee, and an Ombudsman exists at the university level. A human agent can help you escalate.
source: ABES GRC page (https://abes.ac.in/GRC-grievance-redressal-cell.php) + Mandatory Disclosure 18-Mar-2025, retrieved 2026-10-31

question: Can I complain anonymously?
alt_questions: anonymous complaint|complaint box|report without my name
answer: Yes. Anonymous complaints can be dropped in the complaint boxes or submitted through the anonymous option on the portal. Providing details helps investigators act faster.

question: Who is the grievance officer?
alt_questions: grievance redressal officer|contact for complaints|who to contact for student issues
answer: The Grievance Redressal Committee at ABES is chaired by the Director and includes the Registrar, the Chief Proctor, an AKTU official and a senior AKTU professor, with a Member Secretary. You can reach the offices at director@abes.ac.in or registrar@abes.ac.in.
source: ABES GRC page (https://abes.ac.in/GRC-grievance-redressal-cell.php) + Mandatory Disclosure 18-Mar-2025, retrieved 2026-10-31

question: Is counselling support available?
alt_questions: student counselling|mental health support|I feel stressed
answer: Yes, free and confidential counselling is available at the Student Wellness Centre. If you are in distress, Tele-MANAS (14416) offers free 24x7 support in India. Would you like me to connect you to a human counsellor?

question: How do I apply for a hostel room?
alt_questions: hostel application|get hostel accommodation|hostel mein room kaise milega|hostel mein room kaise milega|hostel ke liye apply kaise kare|hostel form
answer: Apply through the 'Hostel' section of the student portal after confirming admission. Rooms are allotted according to availability and the university allotment policy; the allotment letter is issued online.

question: What is the hostel fee?
alt_questions: hostel charges|room rent per semester|security deposit for hostel
answer: ABES hostel fee 2026-27 ranges from about Rs. 1,36,500 (boys, 4-seater non-AC) to Rs. 1,77,500 (2-seater AC), including a Rs. 5,000 refundable security deposit. See abes.ac.in/courses-offered.html for the full table.

question: What are the hostel gate timings?
alt_questions: hostel curfew|gate closing time|late night entry hostel
answer: The hostel gate usually closes at 9:30 PM for first-years and 10:30 PM for senior students. Late entry needs prior approval from the warden.

question: What is the mess menu and how do I raise mess complaints?
alt_questions: mess food menu|today's mess menu|mess charges
answer: The weekly mess menu is displayed at the mess and on the hostel notice board. Complaints can be raised with the mess committee or the warden, and unresolved issues can be escalated to the Chief Warden.

question: How can I change my hostel room?
alt_questions: room change|shift to another room|change roommate
answer: Submit a room-change request to the warden with a valid reason. Changes are approved subject to vacancy and are processed once per semester.

question: Are visitors allowed in the hostel?
alt_questions: visitor policy|guest in hostel|can parents stay in hostel
answer: Visitors are allowed only in the designated visitors' lounge during visiting hours after signing the register. Overnight stay is not permitted.

question: Who do I contact for maintenance, wifi or water problems?
alt_questions: hostel wifi not working|room fan repair|water supply problem
answer: Raise a maintenance request through the hostel helpdesk or inform your floor caretaker. Wifi issues can also be reported to the IT helpdesk with your block and room number.

question: How do I vacate or surrender my hostel room?
alt_questions: hostel vacating procedure|surrender hostel seat|leave hostel
answer: Submit a vacating form to the warden, clear dues and return the room keys. The security deposit is refunded after clearance.

question: What are the library timings?
alt_questions: library opening hours|library kab tak khuli rehti hai|is library open on weekends|library kab khulti hai|library kitne baje band hoti hai|library time
answer: The library is open from 8:30 AM to 8:00 PM on weekdays and 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM on Saturdays. During exams, the reading hall may stay open late; notices are put on the library door and portal.

question: How many books can I borrow and for how long?
alt_questions: borrowing limit|how long can I keep a book|number of books issued|library mein kitni books mil sakti hain|kitni books issue ho sakti hain|book kitne din ke liye milti hai
answer: UG students can borrow up to 4 books and PG/research students up to 6 books for 14 days, renewable once if not reserved by someone else.

question: How do I renew a book online?
alt_questions: renew library book|extend book return date|online renewal
answer: Log in to the library OPAC with your student ID, open 'My Account', select the book and click 'Renew'. Renewal is possible only if the book is not reserved and not overdue.

question: What is the fine for late return?
alt_questions: late fee for library book|overdue book fine|fine for returning book late
answer: A fine of Rs. 2 per day per book is charged for overdue books. Fines can be paid at the library counter or through the portal.

question: Can I access e-journals and digital resources from home?
alt_questions: IEEE access|online journals|digital library remote access
answer: ABES provides e-library facilities, and its library subscribes to national and international journals. Ask the library staff how to get your remote-access login.

question: What should I do if I lose or damage a book?
alt_questions: lost library book|book damaged|replacement of lost book
answer: Inform the librarian immediately. You will need to replace the book with the same edition or pay its current cost plus a processing fee.

question: How do I book a study room or discussion room?
alt_questions: reserve study room|group study room|library seat reservation
answer: Reserve a study room on the library portal under 'Facilities' for up to 2 hours per day. Show your ID at the counter on arrival.

question: How can I request a new book for the library?
alt_questions: suggest a book purchase|request to buy book|book not available in library
answer: Fill the 'Recommend a Book' form on the library portal or at the counter. The library committee reviews recommendations every month.

question: How do I get a library membership card?
alt_questions: library card chahiye|issue library card|new library id card|mujhe library card chahiye
answer: Library cards are issued at the library counter on showing your student ID and one photograph; new students usually get them during orientation week. A lost card can be replaced for a small fee.

question: Is the library open on Sundays?
alt_questions: library sunday|library open on holidays|sunday ko library khuli hai kya
answer: The library is closed on Sundays and public holidays. During exam weeks the reading hall may open on Sundays - please check the library notice board and portal.

question: What are the mess timings?
alt_questions: mess timing kya hai|breakfast lunch dinner time|when is dinner in mess|mess kab khulta hai
answer: The mess serves breakfast 7:30-9:00 AM, lunch 12:30-2:30 PM, snacks 5:00-6:00 PM and dinner 7:30-9:30 PM.

question: Which courses does ABES offer and how many seats are there?
alt_questions: programmes offered|list of courses|btech branches|seats in cse|intake of each branch|mca seats
answer: ABES (2026-27) offers B.Tech in CSE (900 seats), CSE-AI&ML (360), CSE-Data Science (180), ECE (180), Electrical & Computer Engineering (120), Mechanical (60) and Working-Professional CSE/ECE (30 each); MCA (180), BCA (120); M.Tech in CSE (12) and ECE (6). Seat numbers can change each year.

question: How can I contact ABES Engineering College?
alt_questions: college address|phone number of college|email id of college|where is abes located|college contact
answer: ABES Engineering College, 19th KM Stone, NH-09 (formerly NH-24), Ghaziabad - 201009, Uttar Pradesh. Phone: 0120-7135112. E-mail: info@abes.ac.in. Website: www.abes.ac.in. The nearest railway station is Ghaziabad (about 4 km).

question: Is ABES approved and accredited?
alt_questions: is abes naac accredited|naac accreditation of abes|abes naac grade|naac grade|nba accreditation|aicte approval|affiliated to which university|aktu affiliation
answer: ABES is approved by AICTE, New Delhi, affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU), Lucknow (college code 032), and NAAC accredited (Grade A). NBA accreditation was listed for CSE, ECE and ME up to 30 June 2025 - please check abes.ac.in for the current status.

question: How many hostel seats are there at ABES?
alt_questions: hostel capacity|girls hostel available|boys hostel inside campus|hostel facility|hostel seats
answer: ABES has hostels inside the campus: 4 buildings for boys (1,033 seats) and 3 buildings for girls (458 seats). Apply through the hostel / admission office after confirming your admission.

question: What does the ABES library offer?
alt_questions: total books in the library|library collection size|number of books available in library|journals available|e-library|library facilities
answer: The ABES library holds about 1,15,122 books (8,069 titles), subscribes to 179 national and 1,045 international journals, and provides e-library facilities.

question: Who conducts the semester exams and declares results?
alt_questions: aktu exam|aktu result|exams conducted by university|who gives degree|affiliating university exams|who declares results|who gives exam results
answer: ABES is affiliated to AKTU, so semester examinations, results and degrees follow AKTU rules and are published on aktu.ac.in. The college has a Dean (Examinations) office and a central examination facility, as per university norms.

question: What computing and internet facilities are available on campus?
alt_questions: wifi in college|internet speed|computer lab|number of computers|internet bandwidth
answer: The campus has 1 Gbps internet bandwidth, about 1,440 PCs, one computer centre and 89 laboratories (as per the March 2025 disclosure).

question: Which committees handle student complaints at ABES?
alt_questions: internal complaints committee|anti ragging committee|student welfare dean|sc st committee|equal opportunity cell
answer: ABES has a Grievance Redressal Committee, an Anti-Ragging Committee, an Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) for harassment, a SC/ST committee, an Equal Opportunity Cell and a Dean for Campus Life & Student Welfare (dcsw@abes.ac.in). A human agent can direct you to the right one.
source: ABES GRC page (https://abes.ac.in/GRC-grievance-redressal-cell.php) + Mandatory Disclosure 18-Mar-2025, retrieved 2026-10-31
